aspect: HONEST GAP - the combined study does not exist
description: Searches of this literature surface low back pain prevalence, occupational musculoskeletal burden, somatisation and depression separately. No study was located combining somatic symptom scales with back pain and psychological distress in a Nigerian worker sample, and none quantifying absenteeism or output loss. This row says so rather than inventing a figure.
energy_note: The mechanism is documented. The number is not.

aspect: What can be said from the components
description: One-year low back pain prevalence of 40-85%, 61.3% severe depressive symptoms among older adults with musculoskeletal disorders, OR 2.88 linking domestic stress to back pain, and 20-200 days a year of administrative load from PSY-006. Each has a known effect on output; nobody has multiplied them together for this population.
money_note: Order of magnitude only. Do not cite.
energy_note: Four large effects, never added up.

aspect: Why the study is not done is itself part of the dataset
description: Research requires funding, institutional stability, and researchers who have not emigrated. EDU-001 and HLT-002 each remove one of those.
energy_note: The evidence gap has the same causes as the harm.

aspect: SCENARIO - the study that did not happen
description: The researcher who would have run the combined worker-cohort study - somatic scales, back pain and psychological distress in one sample - finished her doctorate in 2021 and has been in Leeds since 2022. Her department has not replaced her. The gap recorded in this issue and the reason for the gap are the same person.
energy_note: The missing study and the missing researcher are one absence.
